specification: FS-01 Formal Lifecycle and State-Transition Specification

global_invariants.statement: At most one implementation section may be active.
An active implementation section requires exact section implementation authority.
A finally closed project cannot have active implementation or migration authority.
global_invariants.machine_rule: final_closure == FINALLY_CLOSED implies authority == NO_ACTIVE_WORK_AUTHORIZATION and active_implementation_section == null

global_invariants.statement: No lifecycle state or decision silently implies another lifecycle state or decision.
global_invariants.machine_rule: dimension changes are limited to changed_dimensions named by one explicit transition record

global_invariants.statement: The transition table is declarative and never executes or applies a transition.
global_invariants.machine_rule: execution_capability == false and applies_transitions == false and writes_lifecycle_state == false

global_invariants.statement: Closed section outcome remains authoritative after closeout; NOT_REQUIRED must not be rewritten.

prohibited_implications.statement: Roadmap acceptance does not imply section authorization.
Work-package acceptance does not imply section authorization.
Draft creation does not imply section activation.
Implementation completion does not imply verification completion.
Implementation completion does not imply administrator acceptance.
Verification completion does not imply administrator acceptance.
Section acceptance does not imply section closeout.
A closeout proposal does not imply closeout application.
Section closeout does not imply next-section authorization.
A migration plan does not imply migration authorization.
Migration application does not imply migration verification.
A final-closure proposal does not imply final closure.

states.title: Onboarding required
states.description: The project has not accepted its development roadmap and no implementation work is active.

states.title: Roadmap accepted with no active work
states.description: The roadmap is accepted, but no section work package or implementation authority is active.

states.title: Work package accepted with no active work
states.description: The section work package is accepted as a planning baseline, but implementation remains unauthorized.

states.title: Section authorized but not started
states.description: An exact section authorization exists, but implementation has not started.

states.title: Section implementation in progress
states.description: The authorized section is being implemented within its exact scope.

states.title: Implementation complete with verification pending
states.description: Implementation is recorded complete, but required verification has not completed.

states.title: Verification complete with acceptance pending
states.description: Required verification is complete, but the administrator has not accepted the section.

states.title: Section accepted with closeout not proposed
states.description: The administrator accepted the verified section, but closeout has not been proposed.

states.title: Section accepted with closeout proposed
states.description: A closeout record has been proposed but has not been applied.

states.title: Section closed with next section inactive
states.description: The previous section is closed. No later section is automatically authorized.

states.title: Migration planned but not authorized
states.description: A migration plan exists, but no migration execution authority exists.

states.title: Migration authorized but not applied
states.description: An exact migration authorization exists, but the migration has not been applied.

states.title: Migration applied with verification pending
states.description: The authorized migration was applied, but migration verification is pending.

states.title: Migration applied and verified
states.description: The migration was applied and verified. This does not itself close the project.

states.title: Final project closure proposed
states.description: Final closure is proposed but has not been applied by the administrator.

states.title: Project finally closed
states.description: The administrator applied final project closure. No active implementation or migration authority may coexist.

states.title: Lc Verification Only Work Package Accepted Pending
Lc Verification Only Complete Acceptance Pending
Lc Verification Only Section Accepted Closeout Not Proposed
Lc Verification Only Section Accepted Closeout Proposed

transitions.title: Accept development roadmap
preconditions: Onboarding evidence is complete.
The proposed roadmap is reviewable.
No implementation section is active.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Roadmap acceptance must not authorize a section.
Roadmap acceptance must not accept a work package.

transitions.title: Accept section work package as planning baseline
preconditions: The roadmap identifies the section.
The work package names exact scope and completion criteria.
No active implementation section exists.
stop_conditions: Any attempt to treat acceptance as activation.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Work-package acceptance must not authorize implementation.
Work-package acceptance must not create or push an implementation branch.

transitions.title: Authorize exact section implementation
preconditions: The accepted work package is unchanged.
The authorization names the section, base checkpoint, branch, worktree, exact files, validation, commits, push boundary, and prohibited actions.
No other implementation section is active.
The project is not finally closed.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Authorization must not imply implementation has started.
Authorization must not imply administrator acceptance.
Authorization must not authorize integration unless explicitly named.

transitions.title: Start authorized section implementation
preconditions: The exact authorization remains active.
The repository and worktree match the authorized checkpoint.
The first write is within the exact file scope.
stop_conditions: First required action is outside scope.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Starting implementation must not widen authority.
Starting implementation must not modify adopting projects.

transitions.title: Record implementation completion
preconditions: Every authorized implementation output exists.
Required implementation commits are present in order.
No unauthorized file changed.
Implementation validations required before completion have passed.
stop_conditions: Unauthorized path or mixed control/product commit.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Implementation completion must not imply verification completion.
Implementation completion must not imply administrator acceptance.
Implementation completion must not close the section.

transitions.title: Record verification completion
preconditions: All required verification commands passed.
The implementation checkpoint is immutable during verification.
Local and remote evidence required by the work package agree.
stop_conditions: Local and remote mismatch where equality is required.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Verification completion must not imply administrator acceptance.
Verification completion must not propose or apply closeout.

transitions.title: Accept verified section
preconditions: Verification is complete.
The administrator has reviewed the implementation and evidence.
No unresolved deviation blocks acceptance.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Section acceptance must not imply section closeout.
Section acceptance must not authorize the next section.
Section acceptance must not authorize integration unless separately stated.

transitions.title: Propose accepted section closeout
preconditions: The section is explicitly accepted.
Required closeout artifacts are complete.
The proposal identifies the exact accepted checkpoint.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
A closeout proposal must not be marked applied.
A closeout proposal must not authorize the next section.

transitions.title: Apply accepted section closeout
preconditions: The proposed closeout is complete and unchanged.
The administrator has reviewed the closeout record.
No active implementation or migration authority exists.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Applying closeout must not authorize the next section.
Applying closeout must not accept a later work package.

transitions.title: Record migration plan without authority
preconditions: The migration scope and affected records are documented.
The plan is explicitly non-executing.
No migration authority exists.
stop_conditions: Plan contains execution instructions presented as already authorized.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Planning must not apply a migration.
Planning must not alter project lifecycle state.
Planning must not imply migration authorization.

transitions.title: Authorize exact migration
preconditions: The migration plan is accepted.
The authorization names exact targets, checkpoint, commands, backups, rollback, verification, and prohibited side effects.
No active implementation section exists.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Migration authorization must not mark migration applied.
Migration authorization must not authorize unrelated implementation.

transitions.title: Apply exact authorized migration
preconditions: The exact migration authorization remains active.
Backups and rollback prerequisites are verified.
Target checkpoint and targets match the authorization.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Migration application must not imply migration verification.
Migration application must not imply project closure.

transitions.title: Verify applied migration
preconditions: Every required migration verification check passed.
The post-migration checkpoint is stable.
No rollback condition is active.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Migration verification must not imply final project closure.
Migration verification must not authorize a section.

transitions.title: Propose final project closure
preconditions: All required roadmap sections are accepted and closed.
Required migrations are applied and verified or explicitly not required.
No active implementation or migration authority exists.
Final closure evidence is complete.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Final closure proposal must not be marked applied.
Final closure proposal must not delete history.

transitions.title: Apply final project closure
preconditions: The proposed final closure is complete and unchanged.
The administrator has reviewed all final evidence.
No active authority exists.
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer any unlisted transition.
Do not modify files outside the exact human-authorized scope.
Do not activate a later section.
Do not apply a migration unless the transition explicitly authorizes migration.
Do not mark administrator acceptance, closeout, or final closure unless that exact transition is being recorded.
Final closure must not create new implementation authority.
Final closure must not silently compact or delete history.
A finally closed project must reject active section or migration authority.

transitions.title: Accept verification-only work package
preconditions: Exact accepted verification-only work-package conditions are satisfied.
stop_conditions: Stop on any authority, scope, evidence, or state contradiction.
forbidden_side_effects: No reusable-product write, next-section authorization, migration, integration, release, or production action.

transitions.title: Record verification-only completion
preconditions: Exact accepted verification-only work-package conditions are satisfied.
stop_conditions: Stop on any authority, scope, evidence, or state contradiction.
forbidden_side_effects: No reusable-product write, next-section authorization, migration, integration, release, or production action.

transitions.title: Accept verification-only section
preconditions: Exact accepted verification-only work-package conditions are satisfied.
stop_conditions: Stop on any authority, scope, evidence, or state contradiction.
forbidden_side_effects: No reusable-product write, next-section authorization, migration, integration, release, or production action.

transitions.title: Propose verification-only closeout
preconditions: Exact accepted verification-only work-package conditions are satisfied.
stop_conditions: Stop on any authority, scope, evidence, or state contradiction.
forbidden_side_effects: No reusable-product write, next-section authorization, migration, integration, release, or production action.

transitions.title: Apply verification-only closeout
preconditions: Exact accepted verification-only work-package conditions are satisfied.
stop_conditions: Stop on any authority, scope, evidence, or state contradiction.
forbidden_side_effects: No reusable-product write, next-section authorization, migration, integration, release, or production action.
